name: Generic Instrumentation Failure (multi-signal)
description: Several unrelated instrument channels fail in different ways at different times: a failed-low neutron power channel, a biased T-avg channel, and a noisy feedwater flow signal. No physical process fault occurs. The exercise is pure fault classification.
briefing: Between t+20 s and t+80 s a series of instrument faults appear with NO underlying plant problem. Use redundancy, cross-checks and physical reasoning to prove the plant is actually stable.
learning_objectives: Systematically classifying failures: process / instrument / control / operator
Recognising that multiple alarms do not necessarily mean a plant transient
Building confidence in the true plant state from independent indications

events.label: Neutron power channel C failed low
